about: While giving thanks for gifts already received, the prayer asks for greater blessings through the intercession of blessed Antoninus, confessor and bishop.

seg.tr: Almighty God, grant, we pray, that, as we give thanks for the gifts we have received, through the intercession of blessed Antoninus, Your confessor and bishop, we may receive greater blessings. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: who lives and reigns with You

ex.w007: The gifts have already been received. Giving thanks is the people’s present action as they ask for greater benefits.
ex.w011: Antoninus is the one interceding. The people who pray are the ones to receive the blessings.
ex.w019: The Latin is comparative: blessings greater or more excellent, not simply more blessings counted in number.
ex.w037: “God” refers to the Son, who lives and reigns with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit.
